critical_code_review_comments: Rename hygiene is clean: APP_NAME/APP_SLUG='rivaloz' in server.py, FastAPI title 'Rivaloz API', frontend title/og tags and footer legalName all read 'Rivaloz'. No orphan 'Rivalo' text in visible UI.
Night Arena theme: canvas cards + ink shell contrast is strong, volt accent used correctly for winner-only, cobalt for CTAs, ember for open-brief counter — spec adherence confirmed via screenshots.
Console emits 401 for /api/auth/me on anonymous pages — expected behaviour (fetches user; falls back to logged-out). Not an error, but consider treating 401 as silent to keep the console clean.
openapi.json is not exposed through the ingress — fine for prod but blocks external contract tests. Consider adding a /api/openapi.json alias if needed.
